column2: Turns traction control off. Ride gently on wet or loose ground until you know how it behaves.
column3: Kontrol traksi akan dinonaktifkan. Berkendaralah dengan hati-hati di permukaan basah atau tidak padat sampai Anda tahu perilaku skuter.
column4: Traction control will be deactivated. Ride carefully on wet or non-solid surfaces until you know the scooter's behavior.

column2: Below 3 km/h, the motor can pull from a standstill as soon as you use the throttle.
column3: Di bawah 3 km/h, motor dapat langsung menggerakkan skuter dari keadaan diam begitu Anda menggunakan tuas gas.
column4: Below 3 km/h, the motor can immediately move the scooter from a stationary state as soon as you use the throttle lever.

column2: Turns motor braking off, so your brakes do more of the stopping.
column3: Pemulihan energi (pengereman oleh motor) akan dinonaktifkan, sehingga rem Anda lebih banyak bekerja untuk menghentikan skuter.
column4: Energy recovery (braking by the motor) will be disabled, so your brakes do more of the work to stop the scooter.
